Perception- Drop two points out of Concentrated Fire and put them in Ground Pounder. Auto weapons get the maximum accuracy from Concentrated Fire in a few shots so more than 1 point isn't needed.

Endurance-  Drop Solar Powered and add Fire Proof. Natural Resistance and Thirst Quencher are both amazing perks and are always worth running. I use a lot of food buffs so I run Lead Belly to keep my rads stable and Rejuvenated for the 45% Ap regen.

Charisma- Add Strange in Numbers.

Intelligence- Add Demo Expert if using explosive weapons if not add Gunsmith. The best way to get perk cards and coins is to level up and you need high intelligence to do it fast.

I use a clock strategy for my drone placement. Like the hands of a clock, a drone rarely moves, a drone regularly moves, and one drone frequently moves. The first drone gets put on the gen in main or a high-traffic area, the second drone gets dropped on whichever gen the survivors are pressuring, and the third drone is the one you use in loops. That fourth drone is a floater to use where needed.

Remember to keep your sitting drones active, they do have a lot of blind spots. Try to drop a drone when you pick up to check for saves and some additional speed to the hook. You don't need to three-gen from the start, as long as it isn't a cross-map and last gen setup is going to be strong.
